total.description: Total job plans matching the filters (all pages).

total_pages.description: Number of pages for this query.

has_more.description: True if there are more pages after this one.

filters.description: Normalized filters applied, by parameter name. status shows ACTIVE when the default was used.

tasks_truncated.description: Present only with include_tasks. True if the tasks of this page exceeded the limit: later job plans in the page have empty or partial tasks; use a smaller page_size.

items.description: Job plans in this page, ordered by jpnum, revision and siteid. Only the requested fields are present; dates are yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss in server time. With include_tasks, each item has 'tasks' (ordered by jptask).

error.description: Present only when the request is invalid. No other field is returned.
